policy: Only facts explicitly supported by the cited primary source may be promoted into publishable pathway fields.

records.claim: The Skilled Worker route requires an eligible job, an approved UK employer, a certificate of sponsorship and the applicable minimum salary; the standard minimum salary is currently £41,700 or the occupation going rate, whichever is higher.
records.methodology: Direct review of current GOV.UK route guidance

records.claim: The route normally requires £1,270 in available maintenance funds, held for the required period, unless an applicable exemption or employer maintenance certification applies; application fees and the immigration health surcharge also apply.
records.methodology: Direct review of current GOV.UK route cost guidance

records.claim: The Student route requires an offer from a licensed student sponsor and sufficient funds for course fees and living costs, with English-language requirements subject to the route rules.
records.methodology: Direct review of current GOV.UK route guidance

records.claim: Study permit applicants must demonstrate sufficient funds for tuition, living expenses and transportation; the required living-expense amounts are updated annually and depend on family size and application date.
records.methodology: Direct review of current Government of Canada financial-support guidance

records.claim: For points-based skilled visas such as subclasses 189, 190 and 491, an expression of interest is required before invitation; the minimum points threshold is 65, but meeting it does not guarantee an invitation.
records.methodology: Direct review of current Australian Government SkillSelect guidance

records.claim: Skilled visa processing priorities are currently governed by Ministerial Direction 119, which took effect on 25 July 2026 and prioritises applications according to occupation and applicant location.
records.methodology: Direct review of current Australian Government processing-priority guidance

records.claim: Visa-required students must demonstrate immediate access to at least €10,000 for academic courses beginning after 1 July 2023, with additional financial evidence required for subsequent years; shorter stays use the applicable monthly/total threshold.
records.methodology: Direct review of current Irish immigration student-finance guidance

records.claim: New Zealand implemented final Skilled Migrant Category and work-to-residence changes on 24 August 2026, including changes affecting wage rules and qualification evidence.
records.methodology: Direct review of Immigration New Zealand policy announcement
